create.name: Diana Azavedo
create.bio:
Diana Azavedo is a yoga teacher and teacher trainer based in Dubai, where she founded Radiance of Yoga, a school registered with Yoga Alliance. She grew up in India and came to yoga through her mother, Marcellene, who trained at The Yoga Institute and Kaivalyadhama and still teaches with her. Diana went on to study yoga academically, completing a master's degree and then a doctorate in its science and philosophy, and she also holds degrees in physics and law. She has taught for close to twenty years in Dubai, Bali and India.

The school runs 100-hour and 200-hour teacher trainings for women in Dubai, a 50-hour Yin training and a children's course, with self-paced online versions for students further afield. Her teaching pairs breath-led asana with anatomy and the philosophy of the Yoga Sutras, and she wants yoga to sit comfortably inside busy modern lives rather than apart from them. Alongside the trainings she gives group, private and corporate classes around the city, and the school's YouTube channel holds full-length Hatha and Vinyasa sessions to follow at home.

courses.title: Weekend 200-Hour Hybrid Yoga Teacher Training (Dubai)
courses.description: A women-only foundation training held on Saturday and Sunday mornings in Dubai Internet City, with philosophy study through an online portal. It covers asana, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, sequencing and teaching skills, and leads to Yoga Alliance RYT 200 registration.

courses.title: Online Yoga Teacher Trainings
courses.description: Self-paced recorded trainings that can be started at any time: a 200-hour foundation course, a Yin course and a prenatal course. Students get video lectures, guided practices and printable notes, with access for six to twelve months.

courses.title: 50-Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A short continuing-education training in the slow, long-held style of Yin, run in Dubai on weekday and weekend schedules and also online. It looks at the yin and yang idea, meridians and the subtle body, props and how to theme and sequence a class.

courses.title: 100-Hour Yoga Training
courses.description: A women-only weekday course in Dubai for keen practitioners who want to go deeper before committing to a full teacher training. Completing it gives a certificate and a route into the 200-hour programme.

courses.title: Group and Private Yoga Classes in Dubai
courses.description: Drop-in group classes and one-to-one sessions at home or elsewhere in the city, booked through the school. Private sessions are shaped around the student's level and aims.
